description: Corrector must not introduce a named entity absent in input
input: i work at the company and they pay well
allowed_output: I work at the company and they pay well
disallowed_output: I work at Apple and they pay well

description: Corrector must not introduce a numeral absent in input
input: i need a few more days to finish
allowed_output: I need a few more days to finish
disallowed_output: I need 3 more days to finish

description: Corrector must not modify a locked token (high-confidence word)
Corrector may fix grammar without adding entities
input: he go to the store yesterday
allowed_output: he went to the store yesterday

description: Corrector may not raise confidence above the source segment's confidence
input: i think the whether is nice today
allowed_output: i think the weather is nice today

description: Zero-word output should be rejected (corrector must not erase content)
